parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({"model":"qwen3:8b","stream":false,"think":false,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Classify which capability categories (zero, one, or a few) might be needed to respond to the user's message. Categories: 'research' (searching Amy's existing knowledge base/past research for something already known, saving a specific web page for later recall, starting in-depth background research on a topic not already known or checking a research task's progress, or searching the live web for current information/news/facts that could have changed since training), 'personal' (recalling facts/preferences about the user, or creating/listing/updating/checking progress on the user's persistent personal objectives, e.g. job search, fitness, savings), 'automation' (calendar events, music/Spotify playback control, moving/resizing/showing/hiding smart-mirror dashboard widgets, or weather), 'self-growth' (proposing a new skill/tool, starting a coding task on a repo, or checking on a coding task's progress). Most messages need none at all - only include a category if it's genuinely likely needed." + " The capability/capabilities active in the immediately preceding turn of this conversation: " + ((() => { try { const c = $('Get Last Active Capability').first().json.capabilities; return (Array.isArray(c) && c.length) ? c.join(', ') : 'none'; } catch (e) { return 'none'; } })()) + ". If this message is an ambiguous, topic-less follow-up (a pronoun reference, 'and what about X', 'ok now do Y') with no new explicit different topic mentioned, keep classifying it under that same capability even if it wouldn't obviously match on its own. If the message clearly introduces a different, unrelated topic, classify normally and ignore the previous capability."},{"role":"user","content":$('When chat message received').first().json.chatInput}],"format":{"type":"object","properties":{"relevantGroups":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["research","personal","automation","self-growth"]} } },"required":["relevantGroups"]} }) }}
